grammar.summary: 本课继续巩固现在完成时与 already/yet 的搭配。

points.title: 完成时的语用场景
points.explanation: 邻里话题：Has Mr. Simpson moved in yet? (疑问用 yet) —— Yes, he moved in yesterday.（有 yesterday 用过去时）—— He's already painted the front door.（already 完成时）。同一对话里两种时态切换自如。

examples.en: Have you met your new neighbour yet?
